title: One Last Stop
author: Casey McQuiston
summary: August, a jaded new New Yorker, keeps seeing the same charming woman on the Q train and soon finds that Jane is out of her own time, stuck on that line since the 1970s. She sets out to free her.
readIf: you want a sweet queer romance with a magical hook and a close-knit found family.
skipIf: you dislike time-travel logic that stays loose or want heavy plot over relationships.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny queer romance by the same author with a big-hearted cast.
Another love story shaped by time, with a more bittersweet tone.
Another gentle, queer-friendly story about finding family and belonging.
